act.name: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
act.source_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law protecting homebuyers and regulating promoters, real-estate projects, complaints and compensation.

sections.title: Functions and duties of promoter.
sections.text: Section 11 sets out the statutory functions and duties of a real-estate promoter.
sections.plain_language_summary: A promoter must meet disclosure, update, completion and other duties under RERA.

sections.title: Return of amount and compensation.
sections.text: Section 18 governs return of amount, interest and compensation where the promoter fails in circumstances covered by the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: A homebuyer may claim refund, interest or compensation for specified promoter failures, including delay in possession.

sections.title: Rights and duties of allottees.
sections.text: Section 19 states the statutory rights and duties of real-estate allottees.
sections.plain_language_summary: Homebuyers have rights to project information, possession and documents, along with payment duties.

sections.title: Filing of complaints with the Authority or the adjudicating officer.
sections.text: Section 31 permits an aggrieved person to file a complaint with the RERA Authority or adjudicating officer.
sections.plain_language_summary: An aggrieved homebuyer or other eligible person may file a RERA complaint using the prescribed process.
